speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. Can you describe the nature of the swelling in your right knee and when you first noticed it? Also, could you tell me more about the familial history of similar problems you mentioned?

speaker: Patient
text: 18-month-old boy. The patient is brought in by his parents due to swelling in his right knee noticed after playing in the park. The parents report that there was no obvious injury or incident at the park that could have led to the swelling. Upon further questioning, the mother recalls that an uncle on her side of the family had similar problems, suggesting a possible genetic component.

speaker: Doctor
text: Does the child have a history of excessive bruising or bleeding from minor cuts, and have you noticed any blood in his urine or stool? I also need to ask if he has had any previous episodes of joint swelling or pain in other areas.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Swelling of the right knee. I also have No recent trauma or injury, Familial history of similar symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: Has the child experienced any bleeding from the gums or nose, and has he undergone any previous surgeries or dental work that resulted in prolonged bleeding? I would also like to request specific coagulation studies to rule out a bleeding disorder. REQUEST TEST: PT, PTT, Factor VIII and IX levels

text: The ultrasound confirms hemarthrosis, but the normal Factor VIII and IX levels rule out classic Hemophilia A or B.
